About your handyman

Meet Roman

Hi, I’m Roman. I have seven years of hands-on experience in construction and home renovation, including small repairs, restoration work, drywall and painting. My construction background also includes building modular homes and three years working with concrete formwork for bridges and buildings. I bring my own tools and typically reply within a couple of hours during the day.
